editionData.description: Global headlines: U.S. Embassy in Havana issues health alert as sanctions limit imports to Cuba (The embassy issued a health alert Friday warning of a “significant increase in diarrheal illnesses across Cuba” caused by contaminated water and inadequate refrigeration); Water crisis in Israel raises fears over impact of Gaza sewage (Five of Israel’s six desalinization plants are offline. Untreated wastewater from Gaza’s destroyed sewage system could be part of the problem, experts warn); and After CIA director visit to Moscow, Putin pushes harder for military win (The rare trip by CIA chief John Ratcliffe failed to persuade Putin to stop the war and may have hardened the Russian's leaders resolve to seek military victory). Markets leaned higher, with 4 of 7 tracked indexes up; HANG SENG INDEX up 1.74% was the largest move. Benchmarks tracked: S&P 500, NASDAQ Composite, Euronext 100 Index, and Public Joint-Stock Company Moscow Exchange MICEX-RTS plus 3 more indexes. Hacker News: Why are European countries moving their gold out of North America? Product Hunt features GPT-6 Astra (OpenAI's most capable model for end-to-end work), WeatherNext 3 (Our most advanced and accurate global weather AI model), and cmmnts (Add a powerful comment section to any website).

headlines.title: U.S. Embassy in Havana issues health alert as sanctions limit imports to Cuba
headlines.summary: The embassy issued a health alert Friday warning of a “significant increase in diarrheal illnesses across Cuba” caused by contaminated water and inadequate refrigeration.

headlines.title: Water crisis in Israel raises fears over impact of Gaza sewage
headlines.summary: Five of Israel’s six desalinization plants are offline. Untreated wastewater from Gaza’s destroyed sewage system could be part of the problem, experts warn.

headlines.title: After CIA director visit to Moscow, Putin pushes harder for military win
headlines.summary: The rare trip by CIA chief John Ratcliffe failed to persuade Putin to stop the war and may have hardened the Russian's leaders resolve to seek military victory.

headlines.title: Trump’s huge Venezuela deal began with a call and a bet on an oilman
headlines.summary: Alejandro Betancourt was warned that taking on the U.S. government as a business partner would have costs, but America's backing already is providing big benefits.

headlines.title: 9 days after deadly Nepal floods, 2 men are rescued from tunnel
headlines.summary: Video shared by Nepal's authorities showed the moment a man was hauled from a tunnel. Nearly 1,300 people have died after flash floods swept through the region.

headlines.title: US imposes sanctions on Turkish bank, prompting legal threat
headlines.summary: US sanctions Turkish bank over alleged IRGC ties, accusing it of facilitating millions in transactions for Iran.

headlines.title: Blasts at Bolivian military base kill at least 10, injure dozens
headlines.summary: Authorities say seven people are still missing after deadly explosions at a facility storing pyrotechnic material.

headlines.title: Malaysia declares emergency in Sarawak as haze from Indonesia worsens
headlines.summary: Country implements state of emergency in Sarawak's Serian district after air pollution reaches 'hazardous' levels.

headlines.title: After Pretoria peace deal, old enemies in Ethiopia’s Tigray find new ground
headlines.summary: The 2022 peace deal ended the war but left key disputes unresolved, giving the TPLF room to regroup as tensions return.

headlines.title: ‘To challenge deadly blockade’: New flotilla mission sets sail for Gaza
headlines.summary: Human rights advocates call for diplomatic measures to guarantee flotilla safety and end Israel's deadly Gaza blockade.

headlines.title: The U.N. backs a new world map showing Africa in its true relative size
headlines.summary: The U.N. has backed a new map showing Africa in its true relative size, with the U.S. standing alone in opposition.

headlines.title: 4 things investigators learned about the dysfunction at Trump's Labor Department
headlines.summary: A report from Labor Department investigators found former Labor Secretary Lori Chavez-DeRemer violated her own department's policy prohibiting harassment. She resigned in April.

headlines.title: 'Hidden tribunals': Immigration court due process in tumult with new locations
headlines.summary: The new effort appears to be another tactic in a broader Trump administration strategy to short-circuit immigrants' already limited due process options in order to speed deportations.

headlines.title: 'The health system in Nepal is not prepared for this'
headlines.summary: That's the grim assessment from the ground in the wake of the catastrophic flooding, which damaged or destroyed 7 health facilities, interrupted routine care and is affecting mental health.

headlines.title: Trump's arch may break ground without final approval. Veterans are trying to stop it
headlines.summary: Interior Secretary Doug Burgum says "excavation work" will begin in the next two weeks, without approval from a key federal body. Veterans who sued over the arch want a judge to intervene before then.

headlines.title: Shenzhen gears up for Asia‑Pacific cooperation after decades of transformation
headlines.summary: What began as a modest coastal fishing village has evolved into one of the world's most dynamic tech hubs. Now, Shenzhen in South China's Guangdong province is ready to share its decades‑long transformation journey. Scheduled for Sept 5, the main forum of the Asia‑Pacific Media Forum will gather diverse perspectives across the region to explore fresh‑growth opportunities, laying the groundwork for the 33rd Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation Economic Leaders' Meeting and advancing shared prosperity across the Asia‑Pacific.

headlines.title: Nepal rules out compensation from China
headlines.summary: Nepal's Foreign Minister Shisir Khanal said on Thursday that the country has no intention of seeking "climate justice compensation" from any specific country, including China, according to a news release issued by the Chinese embassy in Kathmandu.

headlines.title: Alibaba expands cloud footprint with Brazil region
headlines.summary: Alibaba Cloud, a provider of AI infrastructure and the intelligence backbone of Chinese tech giant Alibaba Group, has announced the launch of a cloud region in Brazil.

headlines.title: US and Iran resume strikes, sparking alarm
headlines.summary: United Nations Secretary-General Antonio Guterres has appealed for maximum restraint after the US and Iran resumed strikes in recent days, leaving 18 dead and over 140 injured in Iran, with the casualties including women and children.

headlines.title: APEC role in AI cooperation draws praise
headlines.summary: APEC is playing an important role in translating artificial intelligence cooperation from strategic consensus into tangible action, experts said, as they laud China for providing significant public goods to foster regional AI development.

headlines.title: Jaishankar to address annual high-level UNGA session on September 26
headlines.summary: Jaishankar will address the high-level UN General Assembly session on September 26 during the 81st annual meeting.

headlines.title: Distrusting a system is not a problem at all, it is a sure sign of democratic progress: Former Orissa HC Chief Justice S. Muralidhar
headlines.summary: Former Chief Justice S. Muralidhar discusses the importance of distrust in democracy, humanitarian law, and judicial independence in India.

headlines.title: Nepal floods: 5-year-old among three Indians rescued from Trishuli Bazaar area
headlines.summary: Three Indian nationals, including a five-year-old, were rescued from flood-hit Nepal; 275 remain missing amid ongoing relief efforts.

headlines.title: Missing: boundary walls, bathrooms, blackboards
headlines.summary: Across north and central India, government school education, especially in rural areas, is a challenge, both in terms of the number of teachers in every school and the state of the building that houses children.

headlines.summary: Union Minister Chirag Paswan files a police complaint against Swatantra Bhardwaj for misusing his name amid assault allegations.
